notes.title: Fresh out the oven!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Fellow tree spirits it's almost time to get your hands on [i][b]Tree Kingdoms[/b][/i]! [/b][/h2]

We've been working frantically to knock everything off our wishlist and the game is looking great if we do say so ourselves. 

Here's a quick summary of the latest updates:

[list]
[h3]New music by Thomas O'Boyle (Composer on Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark
Fog of war updated to cloud visual (which is much more in keeping with the game style)
Ice Mesh updated with frozen visuals
New water's edge added to map border
And a bunch of UI and UX optimisations![/h3]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UKm5h5d.gif[/img]


Overall the gameplay is in a wonderful place and we're mostly tackling little behind the scenes things to make the game much more user friendly outside the core experience. 

Thank you so much for your Wishlists, RTs and other support, it's super important for a tiny team like ours. And If you've not shared [i][b]Tree Kingdoms[/b][/i] with a buddy, there's no better time than today!
